cost.plan_note: On Plaid's free Trial plan this costs nothing, for up to ten bank logins over the life of your account. On a paid plan, Plaid bills transactions as a flat monthly fee per bank login, however often the app reads it. The app never uses Plaid's paid on-demand refresh or real-time balance calls. Plaid shows your actual bill in its dashboard under Billing; it offers apps no way to read it.
cost.teller_note: Teller's development environment is free for up to a hundred bank logins.

GET /api/v1/banks/freshness.chain: Your bank posts a purchase, often within minutes as pending. Plaid collects new transactions from the bank on its own schedule, usually a few times a day. The app then reads Plaid at the interval set here, or at once with Sync now. A bank that emails purchase alerts reaches the app sooner: mailboxes are read every fifteen minutes.
